input.summary: Implemented Task Management API with event-driven architecture. Files added: types, event-bus, services (user, project, task, comment, notification), router, main, demo, tsconfig, package.json. EventBus implements publish/subscribe; TaskService and CommentService publish events; NotificationService subscribes and creates notifications. Router exposes HTTP endpoints per OpenAPI and enforces forward-only task status transitions. Demo script starts server and exercises full flow: create users, project, add members, create/assign tasks, change status, add comment, and list notifications. Note: attempted to run `npx tsc --noEmit` but TypeScript CLI was not available in the execution environment.
